user.title: French Pilot-Wire Electric Heating
user.description: Create the virtual thermostat first, then add each radiator.

central.title: Configure the thermostat
central.description: Auto follows the heating calendar: active = chosen mode (Comfort by default), inactive = chosen mode (Frost protection by default for new installations). After 45 s, an open window switches the radiators to the window mode (Frost protection by default).

data.name: Virtual thermostat name
data.calendar_on_mode: Mode when the calendar is active
data.calendar_off_mode: Mode when calendar inactive (Eco recommended, never Off)
data.window_mode: Mode when a window is open (Frost protection recommended)
data.above_target_mode: Order when the room is above the setpoint (Off by default; Eco is only for away / open window)
data.resync_interval: Periodic pilot wire order resend (min, applied after restart)
data.marge_surchauffe: Overheat margin above setpoint before forced Off (C)
data.seuil_detecteur_instable: Unstable window sensor: unavailable transitions per hour
data.capteur_temperature_exterieure: Outdoor sensor / weather (optional, stops if too warm)
data.seuil_exterieur: Outdoor threshold for off-season (C, 24h avg, 1 C hyst.)
data.notify_service: Extra notify services (several allowed, e.g. mum's and dad's mobile apps)
data.persons: People tracked for “Present” (empty = automatic, devices excluded)

room.title: Add a radiator
room.description: Link the pilot-wire relay and the room temperature sensor.

data.name: Room / radiator name
data.power: Radiator power (W, for estimated consumption; 0 = not tracked)
data.energy_sensor: Radiator energy meter (optional; empty = auto-detect a *_energy sensor)
